mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ) AS "screens" , ly.controllers AS "controllers" , ly.services AS "services" , ly.daos AS "daos" , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mp.file_id) FROM analysis_mapper mp WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId}) AS "mappers" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_mapper mp WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mp.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT') AS "sqlStatements" , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.to_external) FROM analysis_relation t WHERE t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')) AS "tables" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.layer IN ('CONTROLLER', 'WEB_FILTER')) AS controllers , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.layer = 'SERVICE') AS services , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.layer = 'REPOSITORY') AS daos FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.outer_symbol_id IS NULL AND f.language <> 'JSP') ly

SELECT COALESCE(s.package_name, '') AS "key" , (CASE WHEN s.layer = 'WEB_FILTER' THEN 'CONTROLLER' ELSE s.layer END) AS "layer" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.outer_symbol_id IS NULL AND f.language <> 'JSP' AND s.layer IN ('CONTROLLER', 'WEB_FILTER', 'SERVICE', 'REPOSITORY') GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT AS "key" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND GROUP BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(s.package_name, '') AS "key" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = e.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = e.symbol_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY 1
SELECT AS "key" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mp.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' GROUP BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT AS "key" , t.to_external AS "table" FROM analysis_relation t JOIN analysis_mapper mp ON mp.revision_id = t.revision_id AND 'S' || mp.mapper_id = t.from_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') AND t.from_kind = 'SQL' AND t.to_external IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(f.file_type, ''), 'JSP') AS "type" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
